title: Increment: show an unanswered measure question empty instead of 0, and save a cleared value even when the form is saved before leaving the field
description: Increment and FormIncrementInput take a new `nullable` prop. With it, an empty value is shown empty, and clearing the field sends null instead of 0. A number field that is emptied now sends its cleared value right away (null, or 0 or its minimum), so a form saved while the field is still being edited keeps the cleared value.
